criteria_quotes: This medical policy outlines Priority Health’s coverage framework, medical necessity criteria, regulatory references, and guideline support for a broad range of spine‑related surgical and interventional procedures across the cervical, thoracic, lumbar, and sacral regions.
Artificial intervertebral cervical discs are medically necessary according to TurningPoint 2.
Artificial lumbar discs are medically necessary when TurningPoint criteria are met.
The following are medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria:
Cervical Spine Fusion procedures are medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria.
Percutaneous Vertebroplasty and Kyphoplasty are medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria.
Lumbar Spine Fusion procedures are medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria.
Sacroiliac joint fusion (open or minimally invasive percutaneous procedure including implants (e.g., iFuse implant system) are medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria.
CornerLoc, TransFasten, LinQ, allograft) without the placement of transfixation device is experimental and investigation and not medically necessary.
Surgery for adults and pediatric members are medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria.
The Tether - Vertebral Body Tethering System is medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria.
Thoracic Spine Fusion is medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria.
answer.submission_route: Submit online, by email, fax, mail, or verbally through Customer Service. Priority Health runs a three-level process ending in Michigan's external review. Online: Online appeal form on priorityhealth.com; email phmemberappeals@priorityhealth.com By mail: Priority Health, 1231 East Beltline Ave. NE, Grand Rapids, MI 49525-4501 By fax: 616-975-8894 By phone: The number on the back of your membership card (verbal appeals accepted) Deadline: Level 1 within 180 days of the adverse determination; Level 2 within 90 days; state external review within 127 days -- but your denial letter is authoritative.
